protocol.app_comparator: Run the actual Full shot, track and face-appearance lanes with a simulated signed Stripe checkout in an isolated database. Keep normal detector selection and measured face/signed-clock evidence within those lanes; omit unrelated large checks. The paired guard can only suppress an existing selected coarse range, and does not pick another candidate. Keep existing short-pass behavior for the counterfactual.

conditions.cross_cut: Both directions per pair. Switch all source pictures and return at exact authored edges. Across pair/direction indices alternate the four fixed short intervals. Keep known non-AI construction.
conditions.long_swap: One fixed 18- or 22-picture local publisher-swap insert per held source. Alternate publisher families by direction.
conditions.ordinary_control: Each source has either a localized 8 px-per-edge camera punch-in or 1.20 RGB gain, alternating by direction. Include one original per pair. The optical punch-in is a deterministic edit, not physical new acquisition.
conditions.short_swap: One fixed six- or eleven-picture publisher-swap insert on both sources of the first four locked pairs, with the other publisher family.

protocol.matching: Read only genuine source pictures for the prior scene study's fixed outer 8x6 grayscale descriptor at output ticks 0,60,118. Maximum-cardinality matching over pairs with a normalized distance at most .15; minimum total distance breaks ties. Keep eight closest resulting pairs, ordered by source keys on distance ties. Skip source overlap and preserve complete assessment of the locked media.
protocol.output: Exact H.264 MP4, 640x360, yuv420p, 25 fps, 120 pictures, CRF 23, silent. Select the closest authenticated native source picture by presentation time, earlier on tie, independently for each output tick. No interpolation or fractional timing correspondence between unmatched originals and swap streams.
protocol.source_role: One prospectively locked held roster. Exclude all 49 original/source/donor groups from preceding localization and scene-continuity studies, including both tracked cut discoveries. This excludes documented links and does not imply unknown portrait identity or general project independence.
